en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Abu Wahab, from Muhammad Bin Mansour who said,
‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic

[7:28] And when they commit an immorality they say: We found our fathers doing this, and Allah has Commanded us for it. Say: Surely, Allah does not Command for immoralities; are you saying against Allah what you do not know?.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Have you ever seen anyone claiming that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded with the adultery, and drinking of the wine, or anything from these Prohibitions?’ So I said, ‘No’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What are these immoralities that they are claiming that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded with these?’ I said, ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Guardian<sup>asws</sup> are more Knowing’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So this is regarding the tyrannical imams (leaders) who are claiming that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded them to be the imams (leaders) of the people. Allah<sup>azwj</sup> did not Command them with being their imams (leaders). Thus, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Rebutted it upon them and Informed that they have said a lie upon Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and He<sup>azwj</sup> Termed that as being an immorality from them’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people has narrated Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Sa‘id from Wahab from mmd ibn Mansur who has said the following.
“I asked (the Imam (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious,

‘When (The faithless) commit indecent acts they say, “We found our fathers doing this and God has commanded us to do the same.” (Muhammad) tell them that God does not command anyone to commit indecency. Do you speak for God, saying things of which you have no knowledge? [7:28]

The Imam (a.s.) said, “Have you come across any one who would think that Allah has commanded to commit indecent acts, drink wine or other such unlawful things?” I said, “No, I have not done so.” He then said, “What is this indecent act that they claim to have committed because of the command of Allah?” I said, “Allah knows best and His deputy also knows.”

He said, “This is found in the unjust Imams. They claim that Allah has commanded them to lead their people and, in fact, Allah has not given them any command to follow them. Allah, thus, has refuted them and has informed (others) that they have spoke lies against Him and their act as such is called an indecent one.”
